comment: Committed tier classification for the gold-set cells (internal/goldset/testdata), assigned before candidate results per ADR 0008. Control-flow and dispatch-dominated cells are engine-sensitive; collection/string-building cells are data-dominated; rule-load is startup-shaped. GoldsetParse/* cells (added with BenchmarkGoldsetParse, docs/profiling-baseline.md's 'Measured per-fixture parse share') measure the reader alone and are identical across execution modes by construction, so engine-sensitive is wrong for them: that tier requires a mode-driven improvement under first-authorization, which a mode-invariant cost can never show. They are classified data-dominated instead -- the reader's own cost is AST-collection construction (Tokenize/parseList/parseForm/parseVector, docs/profiling-baseline.md), and that tier's plain +-5% two-sided tolerance is the correct check for a cost that must not vary by mode. Keys are benchmark names with the -GOMAXPROCS suffix stripped. Reclassification requires a committed baseline profile justifying it.
